title: Union with Christ in Salvation
definition: Union with Christ in Salvation is the believer's spiritual connection to Jesus by which His life, death, resurrection, righteousness, and inheritance become theirs by grace.
summary: Union with Christ in Salvation teaches that every saving blessing comes because believers are joined to Jesus.
christFocus: Jesus is not only the giver of salvation but the living Savior to whom believers are joined forever.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Union with Christ means believers are joined to Jesus so that His death, resurrection, righteousness, life, and future become theirs by grace. Scripture speaks of believers being in Christ as the foundation of salvation.

This doctrine gathers many blessings into one center. Justification, adoption, sanctification, perseverance, and hope are not disconnected gifts; they belong to those united to the Savior.

Jesus is not merely the distributor of salvation benefits. He is the living Savior in whom salvation itself is found.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Union with Christ matters because believers often treat salvation like a list of separate blessings. This doctrine shows that the Christian's deepest identity and security are found in belonging to Jesus Himself.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Think of yourself first as one who is in Christ. Fight sin, suffer, pray, serve, and hope from that union, and teach others that Christianity is not merely following ideas but belonging to the risen Lord.
